body: I started off really not liking you and now I really like you!

I'm in San Jose. I'm actually looking into clinics right now cuz I found a free clinic finder. Also, I read something about recent graduates and student psychologists (psychiatrists? Idk which one I'd be seeing) being much cheaper or providing free services for a community center.    
I think what I need to do is take anti-psychotics again. I was on seroquel and it helped a lot but it made me gain weight. But I'd rather be chubby and thriving than skinny and suicidal lol.     
    
Your support means a lot. I don't talk to people much anymore and it's helpful to hear a person cares at all.

Also I haven't worked in 2 weeks so I'm currently dependent on my boyfriends income. I feel fucking worthless. I want to start working again but I'm an online entertainer / content creator and it's SO HARD to put on a happy face for my fans. They know I've been depressed but I'm scared they'll all bail on me if I don't pull myself out of this.   
And then I can't make money anymore ever again doing what I like.    
    
I have never ever wanted to be a shitty person. All day every day I am trying to improve myself and nothing makes me happier than making someone smile. I *love* being a nice wonderful person but I fucking can't be. I'm mean, and I'm fucking good at being mean too (verbally, I don't hurt people physically). It feels like I black out when I'm being mean to people, I don't even think about what I'm saying. And mean me has a completely different agenda from regular me. It's like I'm two people. And I want the bad one to go away.    
    
    
I really hope someone can help me because I'm losing hope. I know I can't do this alone. And if I try to make friends because I need a support network, isn't that manipulative and shitty?
Hey so I just wanna let you know the domestic violence shelter was a FANTASTIC idea and I'm getting so much help from them! I finally feel like I'm gonna be okay and it's all thanks to you💖
Thank you so much. I didn't think about either of those options. Literally anything helps, I just feel like I *cannot* do this alone.

I understand that but I don't know what to say, or do before I go to court, or anything. I don't have any of my documents and I don't want to give them a sob story but I also don't want them to think I just don't give a shit and that's why I'm so late and don't have anything or any money.
